title: Independent zero-network audit of GMGN batch cardinality diagnostic
objective: Independently audit the one-invocation batch response cardinality diagnostic without network access. Verify exact request budget, input hashes, 20-wallet deterministic selection, structural summary allowlist, absence of identity/raw-payload leakage, and whether evidence supports retaining batch size 20 or repairing transport to one wallet per invocation.
forbidden_actions: Do not issue network, provider, or GMGN CLI requests.
Do not read credentials, plaintext addresses, labels, identity values, raw provider payloads, raw stdout/stderr, proxy URLs, or complete exceptions.
Do not modify application, parser, runner, tests, or external output.
Do not authorize a corrected full rerun unless the cardinality conclusion is supported by sanitized evidence.
